# rails_powered: powered/activator rail propagation, power loss, slopes, curves next to regular rails
# 20 powered rails, then redstone block at the west end (power loss past 9)
# redstone block first, then 20 powered rails east
# same, rails placed from the far end
# powered then removing the source
# source in the middle of a line (lever on a stone block)
# gap in the line: power does not cross, then fill the gap
# powered rails and activator rails mixed: only same block propagates
# north-south line powered from the south end
# slope of powered rails: stone steps, rails climbing east, source at the bottom
# slope with source at the top
# powered rail between regular rails (curve stays curved only for regular rails)
# powered rail corner attempt (cannot curve)
# power through a conductor: redstone block under the rail line (weak power via block below)
# rails with a redstone_torch power
# break chain: remove the middle of a powered line
# support removal under a powered rail neighbor (neighbors update below)
